svg.metadata: {"id": "s087", "name": "银行柜台", "cat": "社会日常", "tags": ["数学", "认识人民币", "理财", "社会生活"], "desc": "沉稳雅致的银行大厅：藏青与金色的墙面，三个带玻璃隔板的编号柜台窗口，左侧 ATM 机与排队隔离带，右侧取号机与绿植。", "stand": {"ground_y": 920, "x": [560, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "logo", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "logo_glint", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}, {"name": "rate_board", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.4, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "counters", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "glass_shine", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "atm", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "queue_belt", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "kiosk_plant", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamps", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#F5F0E8", "wall2": "#E8DFD0", "navy": "#26496E", "navy2": "#1B3754", "gold": "#D9AE5F", "gold2": "#B98C3E", "glass": "#D6EAF4", "marble1": "#F6F3EE", "marble2": "#DDD5C8", "vein": "#CFC6B8", "counter": "#FFFFFF", "counter2": "#EDE7DD", "wood": "#B88457", "wood2": "#94643C", "screen": "#16263A", "led": "#FFC765", "led2": "#8FD8F2", "leaf": "#4E9E6A", "leaf2": "#86C79A", "pot": "#F2EEE6", "belt": "#26496E", "post": "#C9A25A", "atm": "#E9EDF1", "atm2": "#C9D2DA", "lamp": "#FFF0C8", "sofa": "#7FA7C9"}}
